name: 数量選択
prompt:
Create one compact quantity-selector component only. Reference 1 is an existing analysis comparison: the left panel is the quantity control from the original Shopify screen and the right panel is the assigned Japanese mock. Ignore the comparison headings, panel background and framing; do not reproduce a side-by-side comparison. Reference 2 is the exact assigned Japanese mock and controls the output content, 390x94 canvas, spacing, typography and proportions.

Preserve the mock's exact wide 390:94 ratio (about 4.149:1), with no 16:9 canvas, extra blank margins, zoomed-in crop or added page layout. Use a white canvas. Place one quiet outlined quantity control at x=16,y=16, width=358px and height=62px, with 16px outer canvas padding. Inside, keep a two-line left text group with 「数量」 above 「1」; use Meiryo Regular 12px/16px in #6E6E6E for the label and Meiryo Regular 14px/24px in #1D1D1D for the value. Align two 40x40px rounded-square neutral buttons at the right, centered vertically, with 8px gaps and 10px inner side padding. The minus sign is visibly disabled and muted because the quantity is 1; the plus sign remains active and dark. Match the mock's restrained border and button-surface tones; keep all surfaces neutral with no green or mint tint.

Output only this single selector. Do not include the Shopify header, product image, product name, variant, remove icon, price, second item, payment, shipping, navigation, footer, or any other screen content. Add no shadows, texture, glow or extra controls. The buttons are static visual affordances only; do not claim working increment/decrement behavior. Do not edit the native component. The source crop coordinates in the inventory identify an analysis focus only; do not claim they are fidelity-approved bounds.
reviewNotes: Best of two authorized raw ImageGen attempts: attempt 1 is closer to the 390x94 mock ratio (3:1 versus attempt 2 at 2.426:1; target 4.149:1). Japanese quantity, value 1, muted decrease and active increase are present. Both outputs retain excess vertical canvas space; mark needs-correction. No post-processing, native edits, behavior claim, owner approval or implementation.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
